about_the_game:
Do you know why we have to play chess by moving only one piece per turn?

The straightforward answer was the computers back then in 90's only allow human to think sequentially because they were sucks compare to computer nowadays, so as to Artificial Intelligent(AI).

But today, computer has evolved so as to AI, behold what the modern AI has to offer to chess, by changing the rule of the game!!! Now, this is the ultimate test to human brain. Hey, It doesn't hurt to play this game casually, Wishlist now and wait to see what this will ultimately become, we also have no idea what it will become when it's done. All we can confirm is that the mechanism is about the ability to move all pieces per turn.

Assets and all images, including those in steam store page will be updated upon full game released, they are just a placeholder for now cause no artist with us right now, generative AI still a trash compared to artist.

And, will support joystick controller in the future. Joystick for chess? huh? Hey, this is not same as chess and please don't be skeptical, just wait and see.

short_description: Why do we have to be restricted by the chess rule of only moving a piece per player turn? What if we can move all pieces in a single turn? This game do exactly that!!! Plus a pretty good multi kill effect :)
